initial_xrp_drain.source_attribution: Binance proof-of-reserves-labelled hot-wallet accounts per Bitquery address data

post_redistribution_status.interpretation: No outgoing XRP payments were reported from the seven recipient accounts at the cited cutoffs. This does not rule out offchain sale arrangements, custodial credit, or activity after those cutoffs.

aave_path.note: Tether address-level freeze does not automatically freeze USDT deposited into a pooled lending protocol; the receipt position and protocol-level intervention are separate mechanisms.

issuer_freezes.reconciliation: Issuer-reported totals and investigator-tracked wallet totals have different scopes and must not be added.

whaleradar_scope.note: WhaleRadar's latest page is not an independent post-cutoff XRP-wallet status source. Its ETH/BTC aggregate is not directly comparable to Bitquery's broader ETH route accounting.

evidence_classification.confirmed_onchain_observation: Transactions and balances as reported by named public-chain investigators/explorers.
evidence_classification.sourced_attribution: Wallet ownership labels supplied by investigators; labels can be incomplete or wrong.
evidence_classification.inference: The seven new accounts are redistribution destinations controlled by the same attacker, inferred from timing, funding and transfer pattern.
evidence_classification.speculation: The purpose of the split, beneficial ownership of destination accounts, eventual sale route and any offchain disposition remain unknown.
evidence_classification.disconfirming_evidence: No exchange deposit or mixer was found on Bitquery's followed trails as of its cutoff; this does not prove none exists outside the traced scope.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The seven-account split is a custody/operational dispersal step before later movement.
evidence_for: Nine payments from the original receiver into newly created accounts
Small test payments preceded the larger transfers
evidence_against: No outgoing payments reported from recipients at the cited cutoffs

competing_hypotheses.statement: The split is an attempt to reduce monitoring concentration or prepare multiple liquidity paths.
evidence_for: Six principal accounts plus a test account
evidence_against: No exchange deposits or swaps reported in the followed XRP trails

competing_hypotheses.statement: The 50M XRP Binance-labelled transfer on November 1 is part of the attacker trail.
evidence_for: Large transfer from a Binance-labelled account near the incident
evidence_against: No direct on-ledger connection to the attacker address was established; separate source account

source_registry.independence_note: Primary investigator's own multi-chain trace; address attribution still label-based.
Separate public-ledger analyst; uses same public XRPL ledger, not an independent underlying data universe.
Transaction-level alert and address label; does not independently establish beneficial ownership.
Summarizes TRM Labs, Bitcoin.com News and U.Today; not counted as an independent onchain data source.
Distinguishes the two 40M transfers from a separate Binance-labelled 50M transfer; the two 40M transfers are part of the seven-account redistribution.
Tracks Bitcoin and Ethereum; does not track XRP, TRON, Solana, Arbitrum or Avalanche. Not used to assert XRP-wallet status.
Exchange-wide net-flow reporting; does not identify XRP-specific migration.

leakage_controls: Use only information published by each cutoff
Pin ledger heights and exchange timestamps
Separate original theft from subsequent redistribution
Do not treat Binance aggregate reserve replenishment as XRP spot demand

changed_scope_from_previous_handoff: The two 40M XRP transfers at 03:55:31 and 03:56:21 UTC are confirmed as components of the nine-payment redistribution from the original attacker receiver into the six principal recipient accounts; they are not an additional 80M beyond the original theft.
The separate 50M XRP transfer from a Binance-labelled wallet on November 1 remains unlinked to the attacker.
WhaleRadar's latest November 3 page tracks BTC and ETH, not XRP; it must not be used as a current XRP-wallet status source.
